description.narrative: International economic sanctions against Iran have been lifted on 16 January 2016. In the light of this development, the opportunity for strengthening UNIDO TC engagement with Iran will increase. The formulation of a Country Programme for Iran will indeed strengthen UNIDO#s cooperation and synergy with the UN system, thus contributing to an Inclusive and Sustainable Industrial Development.
